title: Escape Room App gone public!
summary: The BCTalent Escape Room framework, a tool for building interactive learning experiences in Business Central, has been released as open source. It provides a documented platform for creating custom rooms and puzzles for training, onboarding, and feature adoption rather than complete puzzle content.
key_points: The escape room framework is now publicly available as open source on GitHub for building custom learning experiences
Only the framework is released, not the complete room content, puzzles, and solutions used by Microsoft
The repository includes extensive documentation to help developers build their own rooms without starting from scratch
The framework can be used for product training, onboarding, guided learning paths, and internal team education in various organizations

quotes.text: the framework, not the complete escape room content. The reason for that is because Microsoft still wants to use it as actual workshop
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why the full puzzle content is withheld, preserving the Microsoft workshop experience while releasing the underlying platform
